verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible server and desktop and mobile apps, so configurable task-specific assistants are a fair axis. The evidence shows no feature for creating custom assistants (personas, system-prompt presets, or task configurations). The LoRA adapters and the ability to serve multiple adapter sets are quantization-recovery building blocks, not a product feature for building specialized assistants.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks
